messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: 在 **2015 年的世界国际象棋锦标赛**（World Chess Championship 2015）中，挪威大師馬格努斯·卡爾森（Magnus Carlsen）成功卫冕冠军。他以 8 比 4 的总分击败俄罗斯选手谢尔盖·卡里金（Sergey Karjakin），赢得了该赛事。比赛于 2015 年 11 月 7 日至 12 月 1 日在俄羅斯喀山举行。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得?" They want who won the 2015 International Chess Championship? Likely referring to World Chess Championship 2015 which was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen defended his title successfully.

But maybe they refer to some other tournament like the Chinese national championship or something else. But likely it's world champion. So answer: Magnus Carlsen retained his title over Sergey Karjakin.

We can provide context: It took place from November 7 to December 1, 2015 at Kazan, Russia. Carlsen scored 8/12 vs Karjakin's 4/12. He became the first Norwegian grandmaster to win the world title.

Thus respond accordingly. No tool needed.
